integration_policy: Only the orchestrator commits, integrates, pushes, or creates pull requests. Workers modify only their reserved resources in their own worktree. Reservations remain until independent verification and integration, or explicit cancellation.

unavailable_worker.blocker: Runtime permits four agents total, including the orchestrator; a fourth simultaneous worker cannot be spawned.
